caption: The drawing depicts a single square grid composed of alternating light beige and pale yellow rectangular blocks, resembling a checkerboard pattern. The grid is neatly enclosed within a thin, hand-drawn black border, positioned centrally on an off-white, slightly textured background. Each square within the grid is evenly sized, with a subtle, crosshatched texture indicating a woven or textile-like surface. Beneath the bordered square, hand-written text is visible, with writing centered below the image, though the content of the writing is not fully legible in this reproduction. The overall composition is minimal, with the majority of the space on the page left empty except for the boxed grid pattern and the small script beneath it.
